We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve NMR spectra and infer aromatic carbons? But we need the compound identity. Maybe the sample is implicit: we have to query carbon NMR to see aromatic carbon signals. But we don't know the SMILES. The tools carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra require no input? They take empty object. Likely they return spectra for the sample at hand (some hidden compound). So we can call carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count aromatic carbon peaks (around 120-150 ppm). Could also use retrieve_carbon_shifts to get ranges for aromatic carbons. But we need to interpret the spectrum.

Thus steps: call carbon_nmr_spectra.
